item.text: {"rule":"First, either the two initially petted cats or the two unpetted cats are designated to remain. Then, of those two, the final cat is whichever one is specified to stay after the second pet (or the other one if the petted cat is specified to leave). The observations do not reveal how those stay/leave designations are chosen."}
